The class names, codes and audit types in standards.json stay authoritative; a grouping never changes which class applies.
author: readyline
question: What do you do for participants?

hint.text: Not sure? Most sole-trader support workers choose Assistance with daily personal activities and Household tasks.

categories.title: Personal care at home
categories.description: Help with showering, dressing, eating, medication and health needs.

categories.title: Help around the house and getting out
categories.description: Cleaning, cooking, shopping, transport, community outings and daily living skills.

categories.title: Therapy and health
categories.description: Allied health, exercise, hearing services and interpreting.

categories.title: Equipment and modifications
categories.description: Supplying or fitting equipment, vehicle and home modifications, assistance animals.

categories.title: Housing and living arrangements
categories.description: Finding and keeping a home, shared living, supported independent living and specialist accommodation.

categories.title: Children and families
categories.description: Early intervention for young children and their families.

categories.title: Specialist supports
categories.description: Behaviour support, support coordination, life-stage transitions and specialised driver training.

categories.title: Business and platform services
categories.description: Plan management, employment supports and digital platforms that connect participants with workers.
